question.text: For a Fast Track Issue (FTI) involving a public issue (not rights), what is the minimum average market capitalization of public shareholding required?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI ICDR Regulations, a Fast Track public issue requires an average market capitalization of public shareholding of at least Rs. 1,000 crore. A Fast Track rights issue requires a lower threshold of Rs. 250 crore. The Trap: Rs. 250 crore is the threshold for fast track rights issues, not fast track public issues. Rs. 100 crore and Rs. 500 crore are not the prescribed thresholds for either route. Note: Distributor-style pro-tip and cross-exam framing removed; explanation now uses neutral Series IX merchant-banking wording grounded in p.100.
